about.title: American Canyon Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision upends everything, and American Canyon's own crash records show these losses happen here too — recent figures counted 46 people injured and 2 traffic deaths in a single year, with reported crashes clustering on Tuesday afternoons along corridors like Flosden Road and American Canyon Road. A wrongful death claim can't undo that loss, but it can help a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or child pursue compensation for funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. This is a civil matter, separate from any criminal proceedings tied to the crash, and California law sets specific rules about who may bring the claim and how much time families have to act. LawProactive connects grieving families in American Canyon with an independent attorney who can walk through these options at no upfront cost, so you can focus on your family while someone else handles the legal groundwork.

whyChoose.title: Why American Canyon Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with certain other dependents or heirs eligible in some cases. An attorney can help sort out who in your family qualifies before deadlines pass.

items.title: A Firm Deadline You Can't Miss
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity is involved. Getting guidance early protects your family's ability to act at all.

items.title: Losses That Go Beyond the Obvious
items.desc: Compensation in these cases can cover funeral and burial costs and lost financial support, but it can also account for the loss of love, companionship, and guidance a family member provided. An independent attorney can help make sure nothing is overlooked.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim after a fatal crash in American Canyon?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If the crash involved a government-owned road or vehicle, that window can be much shorter, sometimes just months, so it's worth getting advice quickly.

items.question: Does it matter that recent crash data shows fewer traffic deaths in American Canyon than nearby cities?
items.answer: No. Public crash counts, like the 2 traffic deaths recorded locally in the most recent final year, simply reflect reported incidents and don't affect whether your family has a valid claim. Each case depends on the facts of what happened, not on citywide statistics.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, they're separate. A criminal case is brought by prosecutors and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action a family can bring to pursue financial recovery for their losses, regardless of the criminal outcome.
